image_location_description: From minifig hands, blade extends diagonally toward the top-right corner

steps.title: Emitter base
steps.description: Stack 3023 (DarkAzure) with 3045 (MediumAzure) aligned as a 1x2 base.

steps.title: Start trans core
steps.description: On the base stud, stack 4x 60601 (TransClear) straight up.

steps.title: Extend blade
steps.description: Add 4x more 60601 (TransClear) to lengthen the beam.

steps.title: Tip & glow cap
steps.description: Add 1x 60601 (TransClear), cap with 2431 (DarkAzure) at the tip.
